opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cit Cer-tiorari granted limited to the following questions: "1. Does a prosecutor violate an attorney's rights under the Fourteenth Amendment by causing the attorney to be searched at the time his client is testifying before a grand jury? 2. If the answer to the first question is `yes,' was such a right on the part of the attorney clearly established in March 1994?"
